note: `language` is sent as a bare code (`en-US` → `en`) and only switches on inverse text normalization (numbers, currency, dates) — the model auto-detects the spoken language either way; batch adds `format=true` alongside it. Filler words (uh, um) are removed unless `filler_words` is true. `model`, `encoding`, `sample_rate`, `channels` and `multichannel` are owned by the adapter on streaming. Streaming and batch are separate slugs because xAI prices them differently ($0.20/hr vs $0.10/hr).

params.name: endpointing
params.doc: Silence (ms, 0–5000) before an utterance final; 0 fires on any VAD silence boundary

params.name: smart_turn
params.doc: End-of-turn model threshold (0–1, e.g. 0.7); pauses below it stay mid-utterance

params.name: smart_turn_timeout
params.doc: Max silence (ms, 1–5000) before an utterance final is forced when smart_turn is on

params.name: filler_words
params.doc: Keep filler words (uh, um, er) in text and words

params.name: vad_threshold
params.doc: Speech-probability gate (0–1; default 0.08 streaming, 0.5 batch); lower keeps quiet or telephony speech, 0 disables

params.name: format
params.doc: Inverse text normalization; requires `language` (sent automatically with it)

params.name: multichannel
params.doc: Transcribe each channel independently; words are merged in time order

params.name: audio_format
params.doc: Only for headerless raw audio (with `sample_rate`); containers are auto-detected
